name: Bio Planet S.A.
summary: Bio Planet S.A. is engaged in the manufacturing, packaging, and supply of organic food items, serving both the Polish domestic market and international clientele. The company offers a vast array of roughly 4,000 products, sold under its proprietary Bio Planet brand, as well as through collaborations with other well-known labels including Alce Nero, Amylon Bio Planete, Organic Food, and Vivani. Its extensive product catalog encompasses a wide range of organic provisions, from essential pantry staples like grains, flours, pasta, and meat products, to specialized ingredients such as algae, mushrooms, and diverse dairy and gourmet selections. The offerings also feature an array of beverages (including teas, coffees, juices, wines, ciders, and beers), various sweets, snacks, spices, dietary items, and even organic animal feed. These goods are conveniently accessible for purchase via the company's dedicated online retail platforms. Bio Planet S.A. maintains its headquarters in Leszno, Poland.
